stories.title: Sufren de más los Chiefs y vencen a Colts en tiempo extra

en.title: Chiefs suffer but defeat Colts in overtime
en.summary: The Chiefs won 33-30 against the Colts in overtime, with a 40-yard field goal by Harrison Butker in the final second of the extra period securing the victory.

stories.title: Refuerza Tamaulipas acciones en Puerto del Norte para garantizar operaciones de comercio exterior

en.title: Tamaulipas strengthens actions at Puerto del Norte to ensure foreign trade operations
en.summary: The Tamaulipas state government has reinforced planning, studies, and technical analyses to guarantee the continuity and growth of port operations.

stories.title: Coparmex advierte que cambios del INE generan dudas sobre elección; pide reforzar los controles electorales

en.title: Coparmex warns that INE changes raise doubts about election; requests stronger electoral controls
en.summary: Coparmex questioned modifications to criteria for reviewing marked ballots and the elimination of verification procedures for public officials seeking to participate as election observers.

stories.title: Brugada pide, desde Nueva York, construir ciudades de derechos; plantea invertir más en zonas con menos recursos

en.title: Brugada requests, from New York, building cities of rights; proposes investing more in areas with fewer resources
en.summary: Brugada called for building cities centered on rights and proposed increasing investment in underserved areas.

stories.title: Inundación en Jalisco daña casi medio centenar de viviendas; alcanza hasta un metro de altura en algunas zonas

en.title: Flooding in Jalisco damages nearly fifty homes; reaches up to one meter in height in some areas
en.summary: Heavy flooding in Jalisco has damaged approximately fifty homes, with water levels reaching up to one meter in some locations. State civil protection authorities established a control center to coordinate emergency response operations.

stories.title: Refuerzan dragado en Puerto del Norte de Tamaulipas ante nueva exportación a Brasil

en.title: Dredging reinforced at Puerto del Norte in Tamaulipas for new export to Brazil
en.summary: Dredging operations are being intensified at Puerto del Norte in Tamaulipas to support increased exports to Brazil.

stories.title: Coparmex pide al INE reforzar controles y vigilancia rumbo a las elecciones de 2027

en.title: Coparmex asks INE to strengthen controls and oversight ahead of 2027 elections
en.summary: Business organization Coparmex has requested that Mexico's electoral institute enhance monitoring mechanisms for the 2027 elections, expressing concerns that certain decisions may reduce verification tools and undermine election reliability.

stories.title: Desbordamiento de arroyo deja daños en medio centenar de viviendas en Zapotlanejo

en.title: Stream overflow leaves damages in fifty homes in Zapotlanejo
en.summary: A severe storm caused the Zapotlanejo stream to overflow, damaging approximately fifty homes. State authorities deployed emergency response and damage assessment operations.

stories.title: ​Brugada participa en el cierre del Urban 20 junto a líderes de Nueva York, Roma y Freetown

en.title: Brugada participates in closing of Urban 20 with leaders from New York, Rome and Freetown
en.summary: Mexico City's head of government Clara Brugada attended the closing session of Urban 20 alongside the mayors of New York, Rome, and Freetown, where city leaders from various countries endorsed a joint statement addressing major urban challenges.

stories.title: Clara Brugada llama a las ciudades del mundo a construir coalición global por la vivienda asequible

en.title: Clara Brugada calls on world cities to build global coalition for affordable housing
en.summary: New York's mayor highlighted affordable housing initiatives and care systems being developed in Mexico City as part of discussions among global urban leaders.

stories.title: Atacan casa de diseñador que bordó vestido de CSP

en.title: House of designer who embroidered CSP dress attacked
en.summary: The residence of Elvis Guerra, an artist who created embroidery work on a dress worn by President Sheinbaum at a recent event, was targeted in a shooting.

stories.title: Atacan casa de diseñador textil zapoteco; denuncia amenazas y extorsión

en.title: Zapotec Textile Designer's Home Attacked; Reports Threats and Extortion
en.summary: Elvis Guerra, a Zapotec textile designer whose handcrafted outfit was worn by President Sheinbaum during Independence Day ceremonies, reported his home was fired upon and he faces threats and extortion demands.

stories.title: Trump no tolerará los intentos de frenar el desarrollo de la IA

en.title: Trump will not tolerate attempts to slow AI development
en.summary: The president rejects growing societal skepticism toward artificial intelligence, which has been fueled by warnings about potential dangers to humanity.

stories.title: Planes Premium de Disney+ “puede incluir anuncios”, pero no es tan malo como parece

en.title: Disney+ Premium plans "may include ads," but it's not as bad as it seems
en.summary: The streaming platform faces user complaints about increasingly restrictive measures being implemented on its service.
